keyboard.description:
Moves focus to the next focusable element within the content.
Note: If there are no focusable elements, focus is moved to the next focusable element after the trigger.

Moves focus to the previous focusable element within the content
Note: If there are no focusable elements, focus is moved to the trigger.
Closes the popover and moves focus to the trigger.

setOpen.description: Function to open or close the popover

setTriggerValue.description: Function to set the trigger value

translations.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

ids.description: The ids of the elements in the popover. Useful for composition.

modal.description:
Whether the popover should be modal. When set to `true`:
- interaction with outside elements will be disabled
- only popover content will be visible to screen readers
- scrolling is blocked
- focus is trapped within the popover

portalled.description:
Whether the popover is portalled. This will proxy the tabbing behavior regardless of the DOM position
of the popover content.

autoFocus.description:
Whether to automatically set focus on the first focusable
content within the popover when opened.

initialFocusEl.description: The element to focus on when the popover is opened.

finalFocusEl.description: Element to receive focus when the popover is closed.

restoreFocus.description: Whether to restore focus to the element that had focus before the popover was opened.

closeOnInteractOutside.description: Whether to close the popover when the user clicks outside of the popover.

closeOnEscape.description: Whether to close the popover when the escape key is pressed.

onOpenChange.description: Function invoked when the popover opens or closes

positioning.description: The user provided options used to position the popover content

open.description: The controlled open state of the popover

defaultOpen.description:
The initial open state of the popover when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the open state of the popover.

defaultTriggerValue.description:
The initial trigger value when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the trigger value.

onTriggerValueChange.description: Function called when the trigger value changes.

id.description: The unique identifier of the machine.

getRootNode.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

Trigger.data-side: The side of the trigger that the trigger is positioned on

Content.data-side: The side of the trigger that the content is positioned on
